description: This file defines the Link2 class, which models a relationship link from a single bean's perspective in the SuiteCRM/SugarCRM framework. It manages relationship loading, querying, adding, removing, and related bean retrieval, and handles relationship side determination and query generation.

classes.name: Link2
classes.description: Represents a relationship link from a single bean's perspective, providing methods to load, query, add, remove, and manage related beans and relationship details.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a Link2 object, loading relationship definitions and establishing the relationship object.

methods.name: loadedSuccesfully
methods.description: Checks if the relationship was successfully loaded.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads relationship data based on provided parameters.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Performs a relationship query with specified parameters.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns IDs of related records, loading data if not already loaded.

methods.name: getRelatedModuleName
methods.description: Returns the name of the related module.

methods.name: getRelatedModuleLinkName
methods.description: Returns the link name used on the related module side.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the relationship type ('many' or 'one').

methods.name: getFocus
methods.description: Returns the parent SugarBean this link references.

methods.name: getRelatedFields
methods.description: Returns related fields of the relationship.

methods.name: getRelatedField
methods.description: Returns the value of a specific relationship field.

methods.name: getRelationshipObject
methods.description: Returns the relationship object this link references.

methods.name: getSide
methods.description: Determines if the link is on the left or right side of the relationship.

methods.name: isParentRelationship
methods.description: Checks if the relationship is a parent relationship.

methods.name: getJoin
methods.description: Generates a join query for this link.

methods.name: getQuery
methods.description: Generates a query to retrieve related record IDs.

methods.name: getSubpanelQuery
methods.description: Generates a subpanel query for related IDs, optionally excluding role-based filters.

methods.name: getBeans
methods.description: Retrieves related SugarBean objects, loading from cache or database as needed.

methods.name: beansAreLoaded
methods.description: Checks if related beans are already loaded.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Creates a relationship link between the focus bean and other beans.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes relationship links between the focus bean and specified beans.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the relationship for a given parent and related record.

methods.name: getRelatedBean
methods.description: Retrieves a related SugarBean by ID.

methods.name: __get
methods.description: Magic getter for relationship_type, _relationship, beans, and rows.

methods.name: __set
methods.description: Magic setter for beans property.

methods.name: addBean
methods.description: Adds a SugarBean to the current relationship beans list.

methods.name: removeBean
methods.description: Removes a SugarBean from the current relationship beans list.
